Package org.tasktide.itemstore

Class AbstractItemStore

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.itemstore.AbstractItemStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemStore
Direct Known Subclasses:
RocksDbStore, SqliteStore
public abstract class AbstractItemStore extends Object implements ItemStore
Abstract ItemStore to implement getting ItemStore attributes, handling the locking/releasing of masterDB for updates, and caching/clearing the master prototype to another file.
